cohort: 266 pregnant women attending antenatal clinics in Bangalore, India
finding: Higher educational status was associated with preference for cesarean delivery, while age, religion, occupation, economic status, gravida, para, number of miscarriages, and number of living children were not.
mod_finding: 90% of women with a previous cesarean delivery preferred a repeat cesarean and were unaware of trial of labor after cesarean; cesarean rates were higher in private (49%) vs. government (13%) hospitals, partly due to maternal request.
